nextGame.note: Tulane has a bye this coming Saturday.

news.headline: Freshman Trace Johnson takes over at quarterback
news.summary: Kadin Semonza threw an interception early in the fourth quarter on Saturday, so coach Will Hall sent in true freshman Trace Johnson. Johnson completed 2 of 5 passes for 35 yards and ran the offense while Tulane scored the last 10 points to win.

news.headline: Maurice Turner wins the conference weekly award
news.summary: Turner carried the ball 12 times for 200 yards and two touchdowns in Saturday's 24-21 win over Southern Miss, including the 74-yard run that put Tulane ahead. It is the first weekly honor of his career.

news.headline: Tulane wins the Battle for the Bell 24-21
news.summary: Maurice Turner ran for 200 yards Saturday at Yulman Stadium, and his 74-yard touchdown run with 5:26 left put Tulane ahead. TJ Smith then blocked a Southern Miss field goal to save the win for coach Will Hall against his old team.

news.headline: Jadan Baugh wins the top offensive award in the SEC
news.summary: The conference named Baugh its offensive player of the week after he ran for 142 yards and three touchdowns against Ole Miss. Two more Gators were honored: London Montgomery on special teams and Bryce Lovett on the offensive line.

news.headline: Vernell Brown is expected to play at Missouri
news.summary: Tests on the knee Brown hurt Saturday came back clean, and coach Jon Sumrall said the news was great and he could be back this week. Eric Singleton, who missed two games with a sprained ankle, will practice fully.

news.headline: Florida jumps to No. 8 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Gators moved up 13 spots in the Associated Press poll after beating Ole Miss 52-28 on Saturday. It is the first time Florida has been in the top 10 in five years.

nextGame.note: Texas has a bye this coming Saturday.

news.headline: Texas stays No. 1 in the new rankings
news.summary: The Longhorns kept the top spot in the Associated Press poll after winning 20-17 at Tennessee. They are 4-0 and play Oklahoma in Dallas on October 10.

news.headline: Texas holds off Tennessee 20-17
news.summary: Raleek Brown ran for two touchdowns Saturday in Knoxville, and his 4-yard run with 5:41 left was the one that won it. Colin Simmons had five sacks to tie the Texas record, and the Longhorns are 4-0.

news.headline: Colin Simmons is cleared to play at Tennessee
news.summary: Colin Simmons hurt his foot last week against UTSA, but he is off the injury list and can play Saturday. Tight end Nick Townsend is out and running back Hollywood Smothers is still questionable.

news.headline: Travis Etienne will not play Monday night
news.summary: Coach Kellen Moore said Etienne is out against Atlanta because of his hurt hamstring. Alvin Kamara will be the main running back, with Kendre Miller and rookie C.J. Donaldson helping.

news.headline: The league explains the fumble that turned Sunday's game
news.summary: Tyler Shough lost the ball in the fourth quarter, Las Vegas picked it up, and the Raiders scored the touchdown that put them ahead. The league's replay boss said the ball came loose before Shough's arm moved forward, so it was a fumble, and Shough said he thought he had thrown it.

news.headline: Raiders beat the Saints 35-27 in the home opener
news.summary: Tyler Shough threw four touchdown passes Sunday in the Superdome, and all four went to tight ends. The Saints then lost the ball four times in the fourth quarter and dropped to 1-2.

news.headline: Charlotte Potvin wins the PSAC weekly award
news.summary: Potvin had 28 kills on 46 swings in IUP's two wins last weekend and blocked 10 and a half balls in nine sets. She hit .636 in Friday's win at Slippery Rock, and IUP has now won ten in a row.

news.headline: IUP wins a five-set thriller at Clarion
news.summary: The Crimson Hawks won 25-19, 19-25, 23-25, 25-22, 15-9 on Saturday afternoon for their tenth win in a row. Delaney Concannon had 17 kills and 18 digs, and IUP is 11-3 and unbeaten in the conference.

news.headline: Peyton Belcher has her best day of the season
news.summary: Peyton had 8 kills in Friday's win over Millersville, more than anyone else on the team. It is the most she has had in a match this year, and she missed on only one of her 14 swings.

nextGame.note: Game 2 of the playoff series with Boston. New York leads 1-0 and a win ends it.

news.headline: Yankees shut out Boston 9-0 in Game 1
news.summary: Cam Schlittler struck out 10 and gave up two hits in six and a third innings Tuesday night at Yankee Stadium, and Ben Rice hit two home runs, one of them a grand slam. The Yankees lead the best-of-three series 1-0 and can finish it Wednesday night, with Max Fried pitching.

news.headline: Giancarlo Stanton is back for the playoffs
news.summary: Stanton had not played since April 24 because he strained both of his calves, but the Yankees put him on the roster for the series with Boston. He is expected to be used mostly as a pinch hitter.

news.headline: Aaron Judge will not play against Boston
news.summary: The Yankees left Judge off the roster for the playoff series because his right calf is still hurt. He has not played since September 16.

news.headline: Warren Easton loses at Zachary
news.summary: Zachary won 49-28 on Friday night. Warren Easton is 0-4 and plays at Riverdale on Thursday, October 1.

news.headline: Warren Easton falls to Brother Martin
news.summary: Brother Martin scored early and often Friday night and won 56-6. Warren Easton is 0-3 and plays at Zachary next Friday.
